_comment: Scoped to ONLY the custom regex manager so Renovate does not overlap Dependabot (which handles gomod in /tools, github-actions, and pip in /docs). Renovate keeps the versions that live outside a package manifest current: the curl-pinned tools in the devcontainer Containerfile, GitLab CI, and GitHub Actions, plus the Go module versions the Makefile installs. Every one is driven by the `# renovate:` annotation above it. Go and Zensical are deliberately absent: they are derived from tools/go.mod and docs/requirements.txt, which Dependabot already manages.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in the devcontainer Containerfile, GitLab CI, and GitHub Actions
Go module versions that the Makefile installs into .tools/

packageRules.description: Helm and kustomize are compatibility pins, not currency pins. They must match the versions the Red Hat OpenShift GitOps repo-server renders with, or local and CI output diverges from what lands on a cluster. GitOps 1.21 ships Helm 3.19.4 and kustomize 5.8.1. Renovate may propose patches inside those lines; a minor or major bump is a deliberate change made when gitops-channel moves, so widen these ranges by hand at that point.
